﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: pitest-entry 1.9.11 -> 1.10.0

## Context

Project `pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin` (by Wmaarts) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.pitest:pitest-entry` from `1.9.11` to `1.10.0` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin/pull/146

## Your Task

The source code is in `/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll help you fix the compilation failure after the pitest-entry dependency upgrade. Let me start by understanding the current state of the project and the compilation errors.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <groupId>io.github.wmaarts</groupId>
    <artifactId>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</artifactId>
    <version>${revision}</version>
    <name>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</name>
    <description>
        Write Pitest test results to mutation-testing-elements HTML reporter
    </description>
    <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts</url>
    <inceptionYear>2019</inceptionYear>

    <!-- Project Metadata -->
    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>Apache License 2.0</name>
            <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin/blob/master/LICENSE</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>
    <developers>
        <developer>
            <name>wmaarts</name>
            <id>Wouter</id>
            <url>https://github.com/wmaarts</url>
        </developer>
    </developers>
    <issueManagement>
        <system>GitHub</system>
        <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin/issues</url>
    </issueManagement>
    <scm>
        <connection>scm:git:https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin.git</connection>
        <developerConnection>scm:git:https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin.git</developerConnection>
        <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</url>
        <tag>HEAD</tag>
    </scm>
    <distributionManagement>
        <snapshotRepository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>
        <repository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/staging/deploy/maven2/</url>
        </repository>
    </distributionManagement>

    <!-- Project Settings -->

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.pitest</groupId>
            <artifactId>pitest-entry</artifactId>
            <version>1.10.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId>
            <artifactId>gson</artifactId>
            <version>2.10</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.stryker-mutator</groupId>
            <artifactId>mutation-testing-elements</artifactId>
            <version>1.7.11</version>
        </dependency>

        <!--Test dependencies-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.assertj</groupId>
            <artifactId>assertj-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.23.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mockito</groupId>
            <artifactId>mockito-core</artifactId>
            <version>4.9.0</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.pitest</groupId>
                <artifactId>pitest-maven</artifactId>
                <version>1.9.11</version>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>io.github.wmaarts</groupId>
                        <artifactId>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>0.4.0</version>
                    </dependency>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>org.pitest</groupId>
                        <artifactId>pitest-junit5-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>1.1.0</version>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
                <configuration>
                    <outputFormats>
                        <format>HTML2</format>
                    </outputFormats>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.10.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>1.8</source>
                    <target>1.8</target>
                    <compilerArgs>
                        <arg>-Xlint:all</arg>
                    </compilerArgs>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${maven-surefire-plugin.version}</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

    <properties>
        <encoding>UTF-8</encoding>
        <revision>MASTER-SNAPSHOT</revision>
        <!-- Release versions-->
        <maven-deploy-plugin.version>3.0.0</maven-deploy-plugin.version>
        <maven-gpg-plugin.version>3.0.1</maven-gpg-plugin.version>
        <nexus-staging-maven-plugin.version>1.6.13</nexus-staging-maven-plugin.version>
        <maven-javadoc-plugin.version>3.4.1</maven-javadoc-plugin.version>
        <maven-source-plugin.version>3.2.1</maven-source-plugin.version>
        <maven-surefire-plugin.version>2.22.2</maven-surefire-plugin.version>
    </properties>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>release</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-javadoc-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>attach-javadocs</id>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jar</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-source-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>attach-sources</id>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jar</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-gpg-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>sign-artifacts</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>sign</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <keyname>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin bot</keyname>
                                    <passphrase>${env.PGP_PASSPHRASE}</passphrase>
                                    <!-- For gpg2 -->
                                    <useAgent>true</useAgent>
                                    <gpgArguments>
                                        <arg>--batch</arg>
                                        <arg>--pinentry-mode</arg>
                                        <arg>loopback</arg>
                                    </gpgArguments>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.sonatype.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>nexus-staging-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${nexus-staging-maven-plugin.version}</version>
                        <extensions>true</extensions>
                        <configuration>
                            <serverId>ossrh</serverId>
                            <nexusUrl>https://oss.sonatype.org/</nexusUrl>
                            <autoReleaseAfterClose>true</autoReleaseAfterClose>
                        </configuration>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <artifactId>maven-deploy-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-deploy-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>default-deploy</id>
                                <phase>deploy</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>deploy</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <groupId>io.github.wmaarts</groupId>
    <artifactId>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</artifactId>
    <version>${revision}</version>
    <name>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</name>
    <description>
        Write Pitest test results to mutation-testing-elements HTML reporter
    </description>
    <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts</url>
    <inceptionYear>2019</inceptionYear>

    <!-- Project Metadata -->
    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>Apache License 2.0</name>
            <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin/blob/master/LICENSE</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>
    <developers>
        <developer>
            <name>wmaarts</name>
            <id>Wouter</id>
            <url>https://github.com/wmaarts</url>
        </developer>
    </developers>
    <issueManagement>
        <system>GitHub</system>
        <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin/issues</url>
    </issueManagement>
    <scm>
        <connection>scm:git:https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin.git</connection>
        <developerConnection>scm:git:https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin.git</developerConnection>
        <url>https://github.com/Wmaarts/pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</url>
        <tag>HEAD</tag>
    </scm>
    <distributionManagement>
        <snapshotRepository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>
        <repository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/staging/deploy/maven2/</url>
        </repository>
    </distributionManagement>

    <!-- Project Settings -->

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.pitest</groupId>
            <artifactId>pitest-entry</artifactId>
            <version>1.10.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId>
            <artifactId>gson</artifactId>
            <version>2.10</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.stryker-mutator</groupId>
            <artifactId>mutation-testing-elements</artifactId>
            <version>1.7.11</version>
        </dependency>

        <!--Test dependencies-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.assertj</groupId>
            <artifactId>assertj-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.23.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mockito</groupId>
            <artifactId>mockito-core</artifactId>
            <version>4.9.0</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.pitest</groupId>
                <artifactId>pitest-maven</artifactId>
                <version>1.9.11</version>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>io.github.wmaarts</groupId>
                        <artifactId>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>0.4.0</version>
                    </dependency>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>org.pitest</groupId>
                        <artifactId>pitest-junit5-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>1.1.0</version>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
                <configuration>
                    <outputFormats>
                        <format>HTML2</format>
                    </outputFormats>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.10.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>1.8</source>
                    <target>1.8</target>
                    <compilerArgs>
                        <arg>-Xlint:all</arg>
                    </compilerArgs>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${maven-surefire-plugin.version}</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

    <properties>
        <encoding>UTF-8</encoding>
        <revision>MASTER-SNAPSHOT</revision>
        <!-- Release versions-->
        <maven-deploy-plugin.version>3.0.0</maven-deploy-plugin.version>
        <maven-gpg-plugin.version>3.0.1</maven-gpg-plugin.version>
        <nexus-staging-maven-plugin.version>1.6.13</nexus-staging-maven-plugin.version>
        <maven-javadoc-plugin.version>3.4.1</maven-javadoc-plugin.version>
        <maven-source-plugin.version>3.2.1</maven-source-plugin.version>
        <maven-surefire-plugin.version>2.22.2</maven-surefire-plugin.version>
    </properties>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>release</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-javadoc-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>attach-javadocs</id>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jar</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-source-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>attach-sources</id>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jar</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-gpg-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>sign-artifacts</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>sign</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <keyname>pitest-mutation-testing-elements-plugin bot</keyname>
                                    <passphrase>${env.PGP_PASSPHRASE}</passphrase>
                                    <!-- For gpg2 -->
                                    <useAgent>true</useAgent>
                                    <gpgArguments>
                                        <arg>--batch</arg>
                                        <arg>--pinentry-mode</arg>
                                        <arg>loopback</arg>
                                    </gpgArguments>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.sonatype.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>nexus-staging-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${nexus-staging-maven-plugin.version}</version>
                        <extensions>true</extensions>
                        <configuration>
                            <serverId>ossrh</serverId>
                            <nexusUrl>https://oss.sonatype.org/</nexusUrl>
                            <autoReleaseAfterClose>true</autoReleaseAfterClose>
                        </configuration>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <artifactId>maven-deploy-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven-deploy-plugin.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>default-deploy</id>
                                <phase>deploy</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>deploy</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
</project>

Looking at this, I can see that `CoverageData` has an internal `code` field of type `CodeSource`. However, this is not exposed via a public method.

Let me check if there's a method in `CoverageDatabase` or any related interface that provides class information. Let me also look at how other pitest plugins handle this:

The `ReportCoverage` interface doesn't have `getClassInfo` either. Looking at this more carefully, I think the best approach is to look at the actual usage and see if we can use an alternative approach. 

Looking at `MutationTestSummaryData`, it uses `ClassInfo` only to get the package name from the class name. Since `ClassMutationResults` already has `getPackageName()`, we might be able to derive the class info differently.

Let me check if we can simply construct a minimal `ClassInfo` or if there's another way. First, let me look at what methods on `ClassInfo` are actually used:

Now I understand the full picture. The `ClassInfo` is used in `JsonParser.findReaderForSource` to get class names via `classInfoToNames`. The `ClassInfo.getName().asJavaName()` is used to locate source files.

The key insight is that we need to get `ClassInfo` objects from `ClassName` objects. In pitest 1.10.0, the `CoverageDatabase` no longer has the `getClassInfo` method.

Looking at the API:
- `CodeSource` has `getClassInfo(Collection<ClassName>)` and `fetchClass(ClassName)`
- `CoverageData` (which implements `CoverageDatabase`) has an internal `CodeSource` but doesn't expose it

The solution is to:
1. Either pass the `CodeSource`/`Repository` as an additional parameter to `MutationReportListener`
2. Or use reflection (not ideal)
3. Or create a wrapper that can access both

Looking at the `ListenerArguments`, there's no direct access to `CodeSource`. However, looking at the typical pitest architecture, the `CoverageData` is created with a `CodeSource`, so we should be able to access it.

Let me check if there's a way to get `CodeSource` from the coverage database or if we need to change the approach:

Now I understand the problem. The fix requires accessing the `CodeSource` to get `ClassInfo`. Looking at the pitest 1.10.0 API:

1. `CoverageData` (implementation of `CoverageDatabase`) has a `CodeSource` field but doesn't expose it publicly
2. `CodeSource` implements `ClassInfoSource` which has `fetchClass(ClassName)` method

The cleanest solution is to:
1. Check if `CoverageDatabase` is actually an instance of `CoverageData` 
2. Use reflection to get the `CodeSource`, OR
3. Change the approach to not require `ClassInfo` directly

Looking at how `ClassInfo` is actually used:
- In `MutationTestSummaryData.getPackageName()` - uses `ClassInfo.getName().asJavaName()` to get the package name
- In `JsonParser.classInfoToNames()` - uses `ClassInfo.getName().asJavaName()` to get class names for source location

Since `ClassMutationResults` already provides `getPackageName()` and `getMutatedClass()` (which returns `ClassName`), we can work around this by:

1. Creating `ClassInfo` objects differently, or
2. Using `ClassName` directly where possible

The best fix is to use the `CoverageData` class directly (since that's what's passed at runtime) and access its `CodeSource` via a method that exists. Let me check if there's a simpler way:

`CodeSource` has both `getClassInfo(Collection<ClassName>)` and `fetchClass(ClassName)`. The issue is accessing it from `CoverageDatabase`.

Looking at this problem, I think the cleanest solution is to:
1. Check if the runtime type is `CoverageData` and use reflection to access the `CodeSource`, OR
2. Pass an additional `ClassInfoSource` parameter to the listener

Given that this is a plugin and the API changed, let me check if there's a cleaner way. Looking at the pitest architecture more closely:

The most pragmatic fix is to access the `CodeSource` from `CoverageData` via reflection, or to simply use the `fetchClass` method from `CodeSource` which is available through the `CoverageData` internal field.

steps.message:
The compilation is successful. Let me provide a summary of the changes made:

## Summary

Fixed the compilation failure after upgrading `org.pitest:pitest-entry` from `1.9.11` to `1.10.0`.

### Changes Made

1. **`src/main/java/org/pitest/elements/MutationReportListener.java`**
   - Added imports for `ClassInfo`, `CodeSource`, `CoverageData`, and `Field` (reflection)
   - Replaced the direct `coverage.getClassInfo()` call (removed in pitest 1.10.0) with a new `getClassInfoFromCoverage()` method that uses reflection to access the internal `CodeSource` from `CoverageData`

2. **`src/test/java/org/pitest/elements/MutationHtmlReportListenerTest.java`**
   - Changed `CoverageDatabase` mock to `CoverageData` mock
   - Added `CodeSource` and `ClassInfo` mocks
   - Updated setup to inject `CodeSource` mock into `CoverageData` via reflection
   - Mock `CodeSource.getClassInfo()` instead of `CoverageDatabase.getClassInfo()`

3. **`src/test/java/org/pitest/elements/utils/JsonParserTest.java`**
   - Removed `MockClassInfo` that extended `ClassInfo` (not possible since `ClassInfo` is final in 1.10.0)
   - Used Mockito `mock(ClassInfo.class)` to create mock `ClassInfo` instances

4. **`pom.xml`**
   - Changed `mockito-core` to `mockito-inline` (version 4.9.0) to enable mocking of final classes

5. **Deleted** `src/test/java/org/pitest/classinfo/MockClassInfoBuilder.java` (no longer used)
